task_description: Resolved S3 MinIO SignatureDoesNotMatch on submission downloads via authenticated streaming API, added direct in-page archive scanning without redirection, and modernized PlagiarismReportPage with BukSU design system tokens, executive KPI cards, and SophisticatedDocumentViewer integration.
role: Master Systems Architect & Apex Cognitive Agent (BukSU CMS-V2 Orchestrator)
root_causes: AWS SigV4 Presigned URL Host Mismatch: storage.service.js replaced internal minio:9000 with localhost:9000, causing browser Host header to mismatch the signed Host header and fail with SignatureDoesNotMatch.

Submission Page Disconnected Archive Checker: Open Archive Checker button navigated user away to an empty drag-and-drop page (/plagiarism-checker) rather than scanning the existing submission file in place.

Legacy Plagiarism Report Tokens: PlagiarismReportPage relied on var(--color-accent) and var(--color-sidebar) rather than Tailwind design system tokens, and lacked integration with SophisticatedDocumentViewer and re-scan triggers.
implementation_details: Backend: Updated getSubmissionFile in submission.controller.js to support req.query.download === 'true' with Content-Disposition: attachment, and updated getViewUrl to return backend API streaming route.
Backend: Registered POST /api/submissions/:submissionId/plagiarism/archive-scan in plagiarism.routes.js with authorize(student, adviser, panelist, instructor) wiring to scanSubmissionAgainstArchive.
Frontend Service & Hook: Added submissionService.downloadFile(submissionId, fileName), plagiarismService.scanSubmissionAgainstArchive, and useScanSubmissionArchive hook with query cache invalidation.
Frontend UI: Updated SubmissionDetailPage.jsx to trigger in-page archive scanning with spinning progress loader and direct file download.

Frontend UI: Overhauled PlagiarismReportPage.jsx with executive KPI cards (Similarity Index, Originality Ratio, Matched Sources), Turnitin-style highlighted marks, search filter, active match detail drawer, re-scan action, and SophisticatedDocumentViewer integration via Inspect in Reader button.
